title: Dress codes: what can you wear?
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
What kind of clothes do you think are appropriate for a professional workplace? Why?
Should companies have strict dress codes, or should employees be free to wear whatever they want?
Have you ever been in a situation where you felt someone was dressed inappropriately? What happened?
Do you think the way someone dresses affects how professional or competent they appear? Why or why not?
If you were a manager, what three clothing rules would you introduce for your workplace?
